{{Top}}
[[File:TuskenCave.jpg|thumb|Entrance to the [[Tusken Cave]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]]]
A '''cave''' was a void in rocky areas on [[Planet/Legends|planets]], some large enough to allow creatures and [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to live inside of them or hide out in them.

Some examples of caves included the Crystal Caves on [[Crystal Cave (Dantooine)|Dantooine]]<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> and on [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Ilum]],<ref name="JQ">''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]''</ref> the [[Neutral Jedi Zone]] on [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]],<ref name="GORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> the [[Korga Cave]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]]<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> and the [[Fitsay]] [[sun caves]] on [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. The planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], although largely a desert planet, also featured a network of caverns throughout the planet, with openings being large enough that a landspeeder could enter them.<ref name="SW1991">[[Star Wars (1991 video game)|''Star Wars'' video game (1991)]]</ref> One such example was the [[Tusken Cave]].

There was also a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the floating city of [[Tolea Biqua]] on [[Genarius]] named [[The Cave]].<ref name="LFC">{{LivingForce|An Official Engagement}}</ref>
